 "data": " flowchart TB
 USERS[\"Many users\"] --> NAT[\"One carrier NAT gateway\"]
 NAT --> SAME[\"Every request arrives from<br/><b>the same IP address</b>\"]

 SAME --> HASH[\"ip_hash only looks at<br/>the IP address\"]
 HASH --> ONE[\"All users → <b>one backend</b>\"]

 ONE --> BAD[\"backend-1 ████████████ 100%<br/>backend-2 ▏0%<br/>backend-3 ▏0%\"]

 BAD --> FIX[\"<b>The fix is NOT a different algorithm.</b><br/>It is a session store, or 
 hashing<br/>on something other than the IP.\"]

 style SAME fill:#fdf3e3,stroke:#b8860b
 style ONE fill:#fdd0d0,stroke:#b04a4a,stroke-width:3px
 style BAD fill:#fdd0d0,stroke:#b04a4a
 style FIX fill:#e8eef7,stroke:#4a6fa5",
 "config": null
